subject: geography
title: Food Chains and Webs
welcome_lead: Who eats whom? Discover how energy flows through ecosystems via food chains and webs.
meta_desc: KS3 Geography adventure on food chains, food webs and energy flow.
final_note: Great work! You now understand how energy flows in nature.

concepts.def: Plant that makes its own food from sunlight.
Animal that eats plants or other animals.
Breaks down dead material, e.g. fungi.

walkthroughs.body_html: The Sun powers plants (producers). Plants are eaten by herbivores. Herbivores are eaten by carnivores. Energy passes up the chain.
A food chain shows one line of energy. A food web shows many connections — more realistic because animals eat lots of things.
Fungi and bacteria break down dead plants and animals, returning nutrients to the soil.
